QuestInfo.name: [Missing Santa] Delivery of Rina cleaning device
QuestInfo.1: You've successfully borrowed a Chimney Sweep and Flashlight from #p1010100#k. Let's take them to #b#p9201030##k in Happyville.\n
QuestInfo.2: You brought #b#p9201030##k a Chimney Sweep and a Flashlight. He thanked you and asked for permission to clean the Chimney.

0.0: How can I help you? You need a Chimney Sweep and a Flashlight? Sure, I can lend you those items. Funny enough, you aren't the first to ask. Well, I suppose Christmas season is just around the corner. Anyway, it's prepared so please feel free to borrow them.

yes.0: You're cleaning the Chimney? Santa Claus will love that! Merry Christmas, my dear!

no.0: Ah, you don't need it now? Okay, Maple Claws must be waiting.

1.0: That's great! You got the Chimney Sweep and the Flashlight! Big thanks! I would love to show you my appreciation for doing this, so hold on!

yes.0: Here, take this recommendation with you! Something nice will happen!

npc.0: You haven't met #b#p1010100##k yet. I want to get started soon before Santa Claus comes to town.
